event.description: Use rank 6 for factorized attention output projection
event.proposal: family: attention organization; retained incumbent is 3776 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0015, shared K/V at 3776/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0017, rank-4 output projection at 3520/0.0% (and attempt-0016 shared-query MQA at 0.02%); prior attempts in this family: 3. Hypothesis revision: rank4 may have crossed the usable post-attention mixing threshold, so retain distinct queries and shared K/V while using a less aggressive rank-6 output factorization, saving 64 parameters per block for 3648 total. This is more informative than repeating rank4 because it changes the tested capacity boundary while preserving the accepted attention score organization. Keep learned positions, reversed operands, ff20, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3776 parameters.
